FN-SL6HU85-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 586
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Commissions
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/09/2026
House Bill 586 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from the
collection of civil penalties of up to $100,000 per violation and $10 million in the aggregate for
a single administrative order.
